cves.description: A security flaw has been discovered in SourceCodester Performance Indicator System 1.0. Impacted is an unknown function of the file /opils/staff/edit_credit.php. The manipulation of the argument credit results in sql injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.
cves.fix_suggestion:
📦 受影响组件：SourceCodester Performance Indicator System
🛠️ 修复建议：
1. 确认受影响的版本范围（见上方 Affected Products）
2. 升级到厂商官方发布的最稳定安全版本
3. 检查官方安全公告获取补丁链接
4. 如无法立即升级，实施临时缓解措施：
   - 网络层：WAF 规则 / IPS 签名 / 零信任策略
   - 主机层：最小化暴露面 / 禁用危险功能 / 输入过滤
5. 修复后使用 NVD / 厂商 PoC 验证修复有效性

cves.description: A weakness has been identified in macrozheng mall up to 1.0.3. This vulnerability affects the function OmsPortalOrderServiceImpl of the file /order/generateOrder of the component mall-portal. This manipulation of the argument coupon_amount/pay_amount causes business logic errors. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The vendor deleted the GitHub issue for this vulnerability without any explanation.
